title: Clinical Trial Data Quality Monitor
short: Supports risk-based monitoring by flagging unusual sites, missing data and protocol deviations across a trial.
symptom: Data problems in trials are found at the last minute
ingredient: A central monitor for trial data
directions: Connect the trial database extracts. Get site-level risk indicators and data anomalies for the monitoring team each week.
problem: Monitors review large volumes of case report form data; inconsistent entries, missing visits and unusual site patterns are often detected late, close to database lock.
why: Late data issues delay database lock and can undermine the reliability of trial results.
solution: Calculates key risk indicators per site, detects statistical anomalies (for example unusual variance or digit preference) and lists open queries and deviations so monitors know where to look first.
data: Case report form data from the EDC system
limitations: Statistical flags indicate where to look, not proof of misconduct
Must be validated within the sponsor’s quality system
review: Clinical monitors and data managers investigate every flag and document the outcome.
